docs.heading_path: Sites
docs.snippet:
Below is the different type of Sites which will be modelled in Maestro.
Distribution Sites – includes both the third-party distribution and IXOM sites
Manufacturing Sites – IXOM Manufacturing Plant
Consignment Stock Sites – to hold the product at Customer Site but still owned by IXOM
Indent Sites – Dummy Sites to create the Sales Order so that Supplier knows which port to send the product to.
During the implementation phase, we will identify all the individual sites to be created in Maestro.

For CAP plants, Safety Stock and Cycle Stock is not applicable. Only the Traded Packaged BU is using safety stock. But, in future, leveraging the safety stock depends on the business choice.

docs.heading_path: Exceptions by Business Unit & Patch
docs.snippet:
ChlorAlkali Caustic Manu Import – follows a slightly different supply planning process based on the supply planned on the Ship, it has a visibility of each ship arrival dates through the form of purchase order which will be created 3 weeks prior to the arrival. And the individual order lines contain information about how much it has to deliver against each delivery location (unload port).
Purchase Orders will be created 3 weeks prior to the due date of arrival. However, the primary focus remains on utilising the supply planning and order management functionality described above.
